units.rawText: Are you looking for something? These books... Yes, they are the result of my early, clumsy efforts, when I didn't know human history well enough. I apologize for this shameful display.

units.rawText: Huh? They're quite something, you say? Well, I feel reassured after hearing you say that.

units.rawText: Once, someone asked, "How could a machine hear the voice of the kami" and questioned the purpose of my existence.

units.rawText: When I think about it, the way I sought to study the history books to learn how our heritage changed throughout the ages and attempted to follow in the footsteps of the gods all stem from those days when I was lost in self-doubt.

units.rawText: To live detached from the mortal world in the shrine and venerate the kami was my original way of life. Now that I have come to the cloud, I ought to try setting foot on a new path by your side.
